problem_title: Call Apex class method on the fly (dynamically)
caption:
Call Apex class method on the fly (dynamically)

🔴 The Problem: Is there any way I can call apex method from class if both class name and method are stored in the string. now I want to call above method.. is it possible ? I was doing research and came across following - (not sure how this works and how to call it from salesforce) http://www.salesforce.com/us/developer/docs/apexcode/Content/sforce_api_calls_executeanonymous.htm

✅ The Fix: With the Callable interface that was introduced in Winter '19 you can now build a light weight interface for the methods you want to dynamically call from a class. The example below is from the docs (tweaked to show dynamic method naming): Example class you want to dynamically call Unit test demonstrating the dynamic calling
